title: Password written straight into the code
plain: Someone put the database password directly in the file. Anyone who can see the code can see the password. NOTE: this is the one type of bug the OLD tools also catch - use it to show the comparison is fair.
diff:
--- a/database.py
+++ b/database.py
@@ -1,4 +1,7 @@
 """Where the student records are kept."""
+
+DB_PASSWORD = "school-admin-2024"
+API_KEY = "sk_live_9f3kDmQ2xP7vB1nR"
 
 students = {
     1: {"name": "Aarav", "marks": [80, 90, 70]},
